text: Given a valid X-Netlify-Token header, when netlify_test_connection is called, then it returns ok=true and a non-empty teams list, with the token value never appearing in the response
Given a request with X-Netlify-Token omitted, when any tool is called, then it returns HTTP 401 naming that header, and the stub NetlifyClient's call count stays at 0
Given an existing site, when netlify_get_site is called, then it returns that site's id, name, url and ssl_url
notes: needs a real vendor account (Netlify has no sandbox environment)

text: Given an unknown site_id against a stubbed 404 response, when netlify_get_site is called, then it returns a not_found error envelope, not an exception
Given netlify_delete_site(site_id=<valid>, confirm=false or omitted), when called, then it returns {deleted: false, reason: confirm_required} and no request reaches Netlify
Given netlify_delete_site(site_id=<a disposable test site>, confirm=true), when called, then the call succeeds and a subsequent netlify_get_site on the same id returns not_found
notes: needs a real vendor account; use a disposable site created for this test, not a shared one

text: Given a site with deploy history, when netlify_list_deploys is called, then it returns deploys newest-first, each with a state field
Given netlify_restore_deploy(site_id, deploy_id, confirm=false), when called, then it returns {restored: false, reason: confirm_required} and no request reaches Netlify
Given netlify_restore_deploy(site_id, deploy_id=<a prior deploy>, confirm=true), when called, then the call succeeds and netlify_get_deploy on that id subsequently shows it as the site's live deploy
notes: needs a real vendor account; also confirm the live HTTP method (POST vs PUT) per docs disagreement noted in the design's Open questions

text: Given a stubbed upstream that returns HTTP 429 for a deploy-list call, when netlify_list_deploys is called, then it returns a rate_limited, retryable=true error envelope rather than hanging past the call budget

Given an environment variable flagged is_secret=true with a value set in a non-dev context, when netlify_list_site_env_vars is called, then that value comes back masked exactly as Netlify itself returns it
notes: needs a real vendor account; asserts this MCP performs no additional masking or unmasking of its own, only passes through Netlify's response

text: Given a valid account_id and key=FOO, when netlify_set_env_var_value(value=bar, context=production) is called, then only the production context's value changes; a subsequent netlify_get_env_var shows every other context unchanged
Given netlify_delete_env_var(account_id, key, confirm=false), when called, then it returns {deleted: false, reason: confirm_required} and no request reaches Netlify

Given netlify_create_env_var is called with site_id set, when a sibling site's env vars are listed via netlify_list_account_env_vars without site_id, then the newly created variable is not returned for the sibling site (it is scoped to the one site, not the whole team)
notes: needs a real vendor account with at least two sites under the same team

text: Given a site with at least one form submission, when netlify_list_form_submissions is called, then it returns the submission's field data and created_at, newest first
notes: needs a real vendor account with an existing form submission

text: Given an existing submission, when netlify_mark_submission_spam is called followed by netlify_mark_submission_ham, then the submission's state toggles both ways, each confirmed by the tool's own response
Given netlify_delete_form(site_id, form_id, confirm=false), when called, then it returns {deleted: false, reason: confirm_required} and no request reaches Netlify
Given an existing DNS zone, when netlify_list_dns_records / netlify_get_dns_record are called, then they return the zone's records with type, hostname and value
notes: needs a real vendor account with an existing DNS zone

text: Given an unknown zone_id against a stubbed 404 response, when netlify_get_dns_zone is called, then it returns a not_found error envelope
Given netlify_delete_dns_zone(zone_id, confirm=false), when called, then it returns {deleted: false, reason: confirm_required} and no request reaches Netlify

Given netlify_create_dns_record(zone_id, type=TXT, hostname=_test, value=hello) followed by netlify_delete_dns_record(confirm=true) for the same record, when both are called in sequence, then the record exists after create and returns not_found after delete
notes: needs a real vendor account with an existing DNS zone

text: Given two concurrent requests with different X-Netlify-Token values against stubbed upstream responses, when both call any tool at the same time, then the response to each carries only that request's own stub data, proven by a shared in-process counter showing no state object is reused across the two contexts

Given a stubbed upstream returning {code: 422, message: 'name has already been taken'}, when any tool call hits it, then the tool returns {error: {code: invalid_argument, message: '...name has already been taken', retryable: false}}, not Netlify's raw body and not an exception
Given a stubbed network timeout (no HTTP response at all), when any tool call hits it, then the tool returns an upstream_error, retryable=true envelope

Given the server is started, when tools/list is called, then it returns exactly 31 tools with names matching the Data & API contract table, none with a description over 500 characters or a first line over 100 characters

Given a Link response header with rel="next" pointing at a URL with page=3, when the pagination parser runs, then it yields has_more=true, next_page=3; given no Link header, it yields has_more=false, next_page=null; given a malformed Link header, it yields has_more=false rather than raising
